events.info: Experience The Sunkicks: Home for the Holidays ? the high-kicking Christmas sensation! Featuring precision kickline dancing, powerhouse vocals, stunning costumes, holiday favorites, and an unforgettable original Christmas story, this Broadway-style event delivers Christmas magic for audiences of all ages. Big-city holiday kickline productions like this rarely tour anymore, making this a unique opportunity to experience a cherished Christmas tradition live in your community. Blending the excitement of grand holiday entertainment with the warmth of family traditions, this joyful celebration is perfect for date nights, family outings, and creating holiday memories that will last long after the final kick.
